name: HG200
description: The HG200 is Hooga's most compact red light therapy panel — a straightforward, portable device designed for spot treatments on the face, neck, hands, or single joints. It delivers the two most studied wavelengths of red and near-infrared light: 660nm and 850nm . With 40 single-chip LEDs producing over 100 mW/cm² at 3 inches and a 60-degree beam angle , the HG200 hits the wavelengths and dose that daily red light therapy needs. At just 3.3 lbs and 9.8" × 6.3", the HG200 is the panel that goes with you. The built-in tabletop stand folds flat behind the unit, and the built-in timer lets you set 5, 10, or 15-minute sessions and step away. Internal cooling fan, zero EMF at 6 inches. Who the HG200 Is For The HG200 is the right panel if you want a targeted device for a specific area — face, neck, wrist, elbow, knee — without the size or price of a half-body panel. It's a common travel panel for existing red light therapy customers, and a popular first panel for people who want to try daily sessions before committing to a larger setup. Compared to the HG300 The HG300 is the next step up: same 60-degree beam angle and 660/850nm wavelengths, but with 60 LEDs instead of 40 and 50% more irradiance at every distance. If you want a slightly bigger treatment area or plan to work on multiple areas back-to-back, the HG300 is worth the small step up. Backed by a 3-year warranty on the panel and 60-day easy returns , the HG200 is a low-risk way to start (or extend) a red light therapy routine.
